# Standard Shipping Cost

**Standard shipping is $7.95**, but it's **free on orders of $75 or more** (after discounts, before tax).

The delivery time depends on your location:

| Zone | Distance | Delivery Time |
|---|---|---|
| **Zone 1** | Under 300 miles | 2–3 business days |
| **Zone 2** | 300–1,000 miles | 3–5 business days |
| **Zone 3** | Over 1,000 miles, remote/island | 5–8 business days |

**Note:** Live plants ship Monday–Wednesday only. If you order after noon on Wednesday, your plant order ships the following Monday.

Is there anything else you'd like to know about shipping?
